items.nl: Topwar: Russische analyse van de nieuwe grondgelanceerde kruisvluchtraket Filin
items.sEn: Topwar author Kirill Ryabov discusses the 'Filin' (Eagle-Owl), a new long-range ground-launched cruise missile. He relies almost entirely on material that Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) published on its War&Sanctions portal on 22 October: debris photos, a 3D model, a component list and estimated specifications.…

items.en: «New russian Filin Missile Consists Half of American, Chinese Components: Ukraine's Defense Intelligence Reveals Details» (Defense Express)

items.en: Ukraine's HUR unveils Filin, a new low-cost Russian ground-launched cruise missile with up to 1,200 km range, built with 35 US and 22 Chinese components and a Russian R500 turbojet
items.nl: Oekraïense HUR onthult Filin, een nieuwe goedkope Russische grondgelanceerde kruisraket met tot 1.200 km bereik, gebouwd met 35 Amerikaanse en 22 Chinese componenten en een Russische R500-turbojet
items.sEn: On 22 October 2026 Ukraine's military intelligence agency HUR published an interactive 3D model, an assembly breakdown and an electronic-component database of a new Russian cruise missile, the Filin ("eagle owl"), on its War&Sanctions portal. According to HUR, Russia began firing the missile at Ukraine in late summer…
